Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the kick-off last week. Per our internal readiness review, engineering needs to close two items before we can approve the on-prem/private deployment window:

- Network CIDR and peering confirmation (we need final IP ranges + expected NAT behavior).
- KMS/secret management handoff: we need Redacted-approved KMS policy and a plan for rotating keys during the cutover.

Can your team confirm the exact ports and outbound destinations the Redwood nodes will require, and share the network diagram you mentioned? We’d like to schedule a 45-minute technical sync with your infra engineers and our network team on Thursday (10/1) or Friday (10/2).

Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance - Private deploy onboarding: network & secrets handoff

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list.

We can cover the port/peering matrix and KMS expectations in the sync. Quick answers up-front:
- We prefer a /22 for the node pool (min) and a separate /28 for load-balancer VIPs; we can accept a customer-assigned NAT gateway in front of outbound traffic.
- Required outbound destinations: S3-compatible control plane endpoints, our telemetry egress (TLS 443), and optional image registries (443). Full host+port list below will be shared by Dev.
- For KMS, we support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) or a wrapped key model; we recommend rolling keys 90 days post-cutover.

Proposed times for a technical sync: Thu 2026-10-01 10:00-10:45 PT or Fri 2026-10-02 14:00-14:45 PT. Which works for your infra team?

I’m attaching a short "Redwood private onboarding checklist" and our preferred statement-of-work items so procurement has visibility.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-private-onboard-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: dev.patel@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@nimbusfinance.com>, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: michael.grant@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance - Private deploy onboarding: network & secrets handoff

Hi team — sharing the detailed port and routing requirements below so you can run this past your firewall/network team. I’ve included minimal security rationale for each.

1) Control plane telemetry & management
- Destinations: control.redwood-inference.com (443)
- Reason: secure config and rollout API calls
- Direction: outbound from customer VPC to our control plane over TLS

2) Model artifact pulls (optional cache)
- Destinations: registry.redwoodmodels.com (443)
- Reason: model layer updates and container/image pulls; can be proxied via internal mirror

3) Worker egress (if using hosted telemetry)
- Destinations: telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443
- Notes: we support a private peering mode to remove public egress if required.

4) Ports between nodes (cluster internal)
- 22 (SSH for our support jump-hosts, restricted by source IP), 50051 (gRPC control plane), 9092 (metrics, optional)

5) Peering/BGP
- We support static peering; BGP optional. If you prefer BGP, we’ll exchange ASNs and establish keepalive timers.

6) CIDR guidance
- Node pool: prefer /22 (min) — e.g., 10.10.4.0/22
- LB VIPs: /28 — e.g., 10.10.8.0/28

Operational notes:
- We require NAT mapping persistence for long-lived connections (KV cache sync).
- MTU: 1500 default; if you have jumbo frames please flag now.

Attachment: redwood-network-runbook-stub.pdf (technical runbook, pared down)

If you can confirm the target CIDRs and whether you’ll allow an outbound NAT or require private peering, we’ll finalize the MAM and SOW language.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@nimbusfinance.com>

Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance - Private deploy onboarding: network & secrets handoff

Thanks Dev — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- We will provide a /21 for the deployment pool (better), and we prefer private peering (no public NAT).
- We require a definitive list of source IPs for SSH jump hosts and the control-plane endpoints so we can lock them in the ACL.
- KMS model: procurement prefers AWS KMS with grants; security will expect key rotation procedures and attestations.

Procurement will send a PO draft today. I’ve attached our KMS policy extract and the internal JIRA for the onboarding ticket.

1) Network CIDRs confirmed: Nimbus will allocate /21 for node pool and /28 for VIPs (Arjun) — please post exact ranges by EOD Thu 10/1. (Arjun)
2) Peering: private peering preferred; Dev to exchange ASN and prep BGP playbook if needed (Dev).
3) SSH jump-host IP allowlist: Redwood to provide fixed egress/source IPs for support (Dev).
4) KMS: Nimbus to provide KMS key ARN and policy; Redwood will prepare wrapped-key flow and rotation plan (Security) — procurement to attach PO (Procurement + Michael).
5) Technical sync: scheduled Thu 2026-10-01 10:00-10:45 PT. Calendar invite sent; please include network and security engineers. (Tessa)

Attachments included in thread: nimbus-network-diagram-v1.pdf, redwood-private-onboard-checklist.xlsx, redwood-network-runbook-stub.pdf, nimbus-kms-policy.zip

If nothing else, I’ll run the readiness checklist after the sync and send a pre-flight validation runbook for your team to execute the week before cutover.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Best regards,
